shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'Cargo.toml' -g 'src/**' -g 'tests/**' | sort && printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/arguments.rs && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/main.rs && printf '\\n--- commands mod ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/commands/mod.rs"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/api/models.rs && printf '\\n--- api client ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' src/api/client.rs && printf '\\n--- models ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' src/models.rs"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | head -200 && sed -n '1,220p' Cargo.toml"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"get_time_entries_filtered\\(|impl.*ApiClient|duration\" src/api/client.rs | head -60 && sed -n '380,450p' src/api/client.rs && sed -n '1320,1380p' src/api/client.rs"
/bin/bash -lc "git log --all --oneline --decorate -30 && git branch -a && git log --all -S'entry bill' --oneline -- src Cargo.toml"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"fn is_running|impl Default.*TimeEntry|impl TimeEntry|duration\" src/models.rs | head -50 && sed -n '300,520p' src/models.rs"

/bin/bash -lc "git log --all --oneline -- src/commands/bill.rs src/commands/bill_weekly.rs src/arguments.rs | head -40; rg -n \"round|ceil|seconds|duration.*bill|bill.*duration|15|six\" README* src tests --glob '*.{rs,md}'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git fsck --no-reflogs --unreachable 2>/dev/null | head -50 && git reflog --all --oneline | head -30 && git remote -v'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/commands/bill_weekly.rs'
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt --check && cargo test entry_bill_weekly_parses_filters && cargo test bill_weekly'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/commands/bill_weekly.rs | sed -n '1,115p'; nl -ba src/arguments.rs | sed -n '155,190p'; nl -ba src/main.rs | sed -n '248,265p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt && cargo test bill_weekly && cargo build'
